why: Customer and family profitability under different cost allocations is not one of the six planted problems. The truth backs the main claim: on true cost, won quote lines carry a 15.98% margin overall, and only 5 of 285 customers are below true cost, all of them small (the largest has $39,554 of won price) (t436, t437, t438). Family 1, which the finding says could go either way, is profitable on true cost (19.87% margin, 0.11% of won lines below cost, t436), so the finding was right not to call it a loss. The weakest families in the truth are 3 and 4 (12.17% and 9.94%, the P2 weld drift), which the finding does not identify.
